name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Over the past 28 days, Quality HVAC by Fibid spent $1,624.32 across Meta and Google Ads, generating 7 tracked leads at a $232.05 CPL, though GHL CRM shows 679 opportunities and 44 won in the same period, which is unreconciled with the 7 ad-platform leads. The biggest movement is a 45% drop in Google Ads spend over the last 7 days, which is likely pulling overall CPL down 28.57% in tandem, while the "Quality HVAC by Fibid" GBP profile is flagged for zero calls despite 206 impressions and warrants an immediate listing audit.

performance.verdict: GHL's 679 opps vs. 7 ad leads confirms an intake gap, not an ads gap.

findings.text: 679 GHL opportunities vs. 7 tracked ad leads in 28 days: CRM intake is capturing volume ads attribution is missing — this is a tracking/intake gap, not an ad performance failure.
Intake owner unconfirmed (due 2026-08-31, 14 days overdue): Vivian left 7/7 and speed-to-lead automations may point at an empty seat, blocking all scale-up decisions per SOW gate.
5 milestones overdue (booking bot, intake owner, review boost, financing page, Homer Glen branch, LSA re-enable by 2026-09-01): none show a completed event; LSA heating toggle is now 13 days overdue.

Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP: 206 impressions, 0 calls, 0 directions over 28 days (call rate 0.000) — listing likely has a broken or missing phone number; Fibid Heating & Air also low at 0.0085 call rate.

3-day spend signal (Sep 11–13): $44.69 + $32.79 + $32.29 = $109.77 vs. prior 3 days (Sep 8–10): $47.59 + $71.73 + $40.79 = $160.11 — Google spend contracting (-45% 7d delta) while lead volume holds at 0–1/day; not yet a confirmed efficiency loss but trend warrants watch.

suggestions.text: Audit Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP phone number immediately — 0 calls from 206 impressions is a broken listing.
suggestions.monday_update: The Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP profile recorded 206 impressions but zero calls and zero direction requests over 28 days (call rate 0.000), strongly indicating a missing or broken phone number on the listing. Action: log into the GBP dashboard, verify the primary phone number is present and correct, and check for any suppressed edits or listing suspensions. Success is confirmed when the call rate on this profile rises above 0.010 within the next 14 days (by 2026-09-28).

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL seat assignment — scale-up gate is 14 days overdue; automations may be routing to an empty seat.

Success is a named owner with a confirmed active GHL login reported to Sohib by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Watch Google spend contraction — if 3-day daily average stays below $15 by Sep 17, escalate to budget-floor review.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads spend dropped 45% over the last 7 days; the most recent 3-day average is $36.59/day vs. $53.37 in the prior 3 days. This may reflect intentional throttling per the SOW demand-control narrative, but no approved decision confirms it. Watch the Google daily spend figure through 2026-09-17; if the daily average remains below $15 for 3 consecutive days without a documented pause rationale, bring it to Sohib for a budget-floor decision before the LSA re-enable milestone (already 13 days overdue) further complicates attribution.
